svg.title: Why windshield edges fade into black dots
svg.desc: A ceramic frit band protects the polyurethane bond from ultraviolet exposure and conceals the mounting zone. Its dot matrix makes the transition into clear glass more gradual.

text.tspan: Why windshield edges fade into black dots
The opaque band and dot matrix are fired ceramic enamel, but they solve different problems at the glass edge.

image.title: Conceptual corner cutaway of a windshield showing transparent glass, a dark ceramic frit band, a dot matrix, polyurethane adhesive and mounting flange. It contains no text or labels and is not to scale.

The dots shrink toward clear glass, making the
visual and thermal change less abrupt.
